business_problem: ABN AMRO wanted digital customer interactions to feel more personal while preserving the security, privacy, and operational discipline required for banking services.
solution_summary: ABN AMRO used Capgemini and Microsoft to redesign conversational banking around a new generative-AI service model. The engagement started with inspirational sessions and workshops to define a three-layer digital support journey and identify where conversational AI could make customer interactions feel more personal. To execute that roadmap, the bank transitioned to Microsoft Copilot as the foundation for new large-language-model solutions and established security, privacy, and architecture guardrails before implementation. The first customer-facing deployment was Rikkie, a Gen AI chatbot introduced through Tikkie and then expanded toward the bank's broader conversational platform. Customer questions flow into the digital service layer, where Gen AI handles natural-language interactions and can scale personalized self-service before cases require human support. The result is a reusable Gen AI factory model that ABN AMRO can extend across future customer-service use cases.
